mapper.insert: insert into play_predict_bet (node_id, topic_id, activity_id, play_day, member_id, option_key, reward_status, create_time) values (#{nodeId}, #{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE}, #{memberId}, #{optionKey}, #{rewardStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from play_predict_bet where node_id = #{nodeId} and play_day = #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE} and member_id = #{memberId}
select * from play_predict_bet where node_id = #{nodeId} and play_day = #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE}
mapper.insert: insert into play_predict_result (node_id, play_day, settle_status, create_time) values (#{nodeId}, #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from play_predict_result where node_id = #{nodeId} and play_day = #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE}
mapper.update: update play_predict_result set settled_option = #{settledOption}, settle_status = #{settleStatus}, settled_by = #{settledBy}, settled_at = #{settledAt} where node_id = #{nodeId} and play_day = #{playDay,jdbcType=DATE} and settle_status = 0
